name: Misguidance
body:
School divination [curse]; Level cleric/oracle 0, druid 0, inquisitor 0, summoner/unchained summoner 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 minute or until discharged
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell imposes a divine curse of bad decision making on the subject with a touch.

The creature gets a -1 penalty on a single attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. You must choose to impose the penalty before they make the roll to which it applies.
